text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'ICON-D2's mean absolute error minus ICON-EU's, in points of capacity. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Both models run every 3 hours, so at each hour both are served at the same lead. Post hoc: the hourly and by-lead rows were added after the first run. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. 6 solar farms in Lincolnshire, December 2022 to September 2026.'
text.tspan: ICON-D2's mean absolute error minus ICON-EU's, in points of capacity. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output.
Both models run every 3 hours, so at each hour both are served at the same lead. Post hoc: the hourly and by-lead rows were added after the first run.
Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. 6 solar farms in Lincolnshire, December 2022 to September 2026.
